AboveControl.note: Label doing its real job: uppercase token label tied by htmlFor to an input and a textarea. Clear vertical rhythm between the three pairs.

BesideControl.note: Beside a checkbox and a switch the label becomes the clickable text of the row; baseline alignment with both controls is correct.

RequiredAndOptional.note: Required and Optional ride in the label's own flex gap as meta — required in foreground, optional in muted — so status is carried by weight, not colour.

WithDisabledControl.note: peer-disabled carries both labels down with their controls; the whole row fades together instead of leaving live-looking text beside a dead control.
